race.comment: BOUTIQUE BELLE (7) has trialled nicely coming into her return effort, winning a recent trial with Pike aboard. The blinkers come off for her return and she maps to get every chance. Rates highly on her form last campaign and she can resume on a positive note. BLUE SPARX (10) has shown good talent in his first two starts, missing by 1.4L at this track and trip 21 days ago. Gets winkers on for the first time today and maps to get a much better run in transit. Third-up now and looks poised to strike. PERFUME PRINCESS (11) is third-up now and can't be discounted. BESTON STREET (4) gets CJP on board now and won't be far away.
